problem: How many books did the second graders return to the school library on Monday? The morning class brought back 26, and the afternoon class brought back 18.

follow_ups.question: The librarian shelved 20 of those books before lunch. Find the number still waiting on the cart.

problem: Can you tell how many of the balls in the under-9 team's shed are orange? The shed holds 32 balls, 19 of them white and all the rest orange.

follow_ups.question: Coach Ruiz buys 6 new orange balls. Now how many orange balls are in the shed?
What is the total number of balls in the shed after that?

problem: How many reptiles live in the zoo's reptile house? Keepers count 47 lizards, 68 snakes and 29 turtles there.
Grandpa Tomasz planted 45 bulbs by the garden path. How many of them were tulips, if 28 were daffodils and there were no other kinds? He always plants his bulbs before the first frost.

follow_ups.question: In spring, squirrels dig up 5 of the tulip bulbs. How many tulip bulbs are still in the ground?

problem: What is the number of basketballs the team owns? After practice, 15 were left in the rack and 9 were left in the coach's bag, and that is all of them.

follow_ups.question: A parent gives the team 6 new basketballs. How many does the team own now?
If the balls are split evenly between 2 practice courts, how many does each court get?

problem: How many adults swam at the town pool on Saturday? The pool sold 96 tickets that day, and 58 of them went to children.

follow_ups.question: On Sunday, 12 more adults came than on Saturday. How many adults came on Sunday?
Find the number of adults who swam over the two days.
An adult ticket costs 4 dollars. How much did the adults pay over the two days?

problem: How many fish did Priya count? She stood by Tank 5 at the aquarium and saw 23 clownfish and 14 angelfish.

follow_ups.question: Then a diver dropped in some food, and 8 more fish swam out from behind the rocks. How many fish could Priya see then?

problem: Can you find how many fossil teeth are on display? The dinosaur room at the museum shows 52 fossils, and 37 of those are bones. All the other fossils there are teeth.
The school bus was full this morning. How many children were on it, if 19 sat downstairs and 24 sat upstairs?

follow_ups.question: At the first stop, 7 children got off. How many stayed on the bus?

problem: How many seats are in the back car of the little train at the station? The train has 64 seats in its two cars, and the front car holds 36 of them. It is painted bright red with a yellow stripe.

follow_ups.question: At the station, 9 passengers sit down in the back car. How many seats in the back car are still empty?
Then 5 more people take seats in the back car. What number of empty seats remain there?

problem: How many suitcases went round the luggage belt this afternoon? The flight from Lisbon left 85 bags on the belt, and the flight from Oslo left 67.

follow_ups.question: Travellers picked up 90 of those bags in the first ten minutes. How many bags were still going round?

problem: How many purple balloons were at Kemi's 7th birthday party? Her mum blew up 40 balloons, and 23 of them were pink; the others were purple.

follow_ups.question: During the games, 4 purple balloons popped. How many purple balloons were left?
No pink balloons popped. What is the total number of balloons left?
Kemi's 9 guests share those balloons equally when they go home. How many does each guest take?

problem: How many books are there in the library's reading corner? On the low shelves sit 76 picture books, and on the high shelves sit 58 chapter books.

follow_ups.question: The librarian adds 25 new comics to the corner. What is the total of books and comics now?
Then a class borrows 40 of them. How many are still in the corner?

problem: At soccer camp, how many players wear red shirts? There are 22 players; 13 wear blue and everyone else wears red.
At feeding time, how many penguins does keeper Aisha feed? She feeds 34 at the outdoor pool and 18 inside the cave. The penguins clap their flippers when they see her bucket.

follow_ups.question: If every penguin gets 2 fish, how many fish does Aisha need?

problem: How many plants grow in the third bed of the school garden? The garden has 85 plants in all: 32 in the first bed, 27 in the second, and the rest in the third.

follow_ups.question: The children plant 8 more seedlings in the third bed. How many plants does that bed have now?
What is the number of plants in the whole garden now?

problem: What was the Hawks' final score? They scored 28 points in the first half and 31 in the second, and player number 11 made the last basket.

follow_ups.question: The Owls scored 7 fewer points than the Hawks. What was the Owls' score?
Find the number of points both teams scored in the whole game.
In their next game the Hawks scored 6 more points than in this one. How many points was that?

problem: Altogether 38 children take swimming lessons at the pool. How many are in the afternoon group, if 21 come in the morning?

follow_ups.question: Then 4 children move from the morning group to the afternoon group. How many are in the afternoon group now?

problem: Last month, how many keyrings did the aquarium gift shop sell? It sold 64 with sharks on them and 79 with octopuses.
What number of gold coins sit in the museum's glass case? The case holds 50 old coins, each one silver or gold, and Ravi counts 33 silver ones.

follow_ups.question: A collector lends the museum 6 more gold coins. How many gold coins are in the case now?
Altogether, how many coins does the case hold now?

problem: How many passengers are on the night bus? Twelve people are sitting down and 9 are standing near the doors.

follow_ups.question: At the next stop, 5 of the standing passengers find seats. How many people are sitting now?

problem: How many bikes in the station's rack are not locked? At 8 in the morning the rack holds 48 bikes, and 29 of them are locked.

follow_ups.question: A guard locks 7 of the unlocked bikes. How many bikes are still unlocked?

problem: Find the number of planes at the small airport: 16 are parked beside the hangar and 7 are inside it.
Sofia's dad baked 30 cupcakes for her party: 18 chocolate ones, and vanilla for all the rest. How many vanilla cupcakes did he make? The party was held in the back yard under a big tent.

follow_ups.question: The guests ate all but 3 of the vanilla cupcakes. How many vanilla cupcakes did they eat?

problem: How many bookmarks did the school library give away at the book fair? Children took 35 and parents took 26.

follow_ups.question: The library had printed 80 bookmarks for the fair. How many were not given away?
Next week the librarian gives away 12 more of them. Work out how many are left after that.

problem: The soccer club counted 75 players at summer camp, all from three teams. What is the size of the senior team, if the juniors brought 28 players and the middle team brought 24?

follow_ups.question: Five seniors go home early with a cold. How many seniors are still at camp?
The coach splits those seniors into 2 equal teams for a match. How many players are on each team?

problem: Saturday was busy at the monkey house, which is home to 14 monkeys. How many visitors came that day, if 86 came before lunch and 59 after lunch?

follow_ups.question: On Sunday, 30 fewer visitors came than on Saturday. What was Sunday's number of visitors?

problem: Lucia picked 41 flowers from her garden for a bunch, roses and lilies only. If she picked 25 roses, how many lilies are in the bunch?
How many fans filled the stands at the basketball final? Riverside School brought 47 of them and Hillcrest School brought 56.

follow_ups.question: At half time, 18 fans went out to buy snacks. How many fans stayed in the stands?

problem: How many of the pool's lockers are missing their keys? The changing room has 60 lockers, and only 42 still have a key in the lock. The lifeguard keeps spare towels on the top shelf.

follow_ups.question: The manager finds 10 of the missing keys in a drawer. How many keys are still missing?

problem: What is the total number of starfish and crabs in the aquarium's touch pool? There are 12 starfish, and there are fewer crabs: only 9.

follow_ups.question: A keeper adds 3 sea urchins to the touch pool. How many animals live there now?

problem: Room 12 of the art museum has 45 paintings. Every painting there is either a landscape or a portrait, and 27 are landscapes. Can you say how many are portraits?

follow_ups.question: The museum moves 6 portraits into storage. How many portraits are still on the walls?

problem: How many students went to the coast? They needed two buses: 57 rode in the first one and 48 rode in the second.

follow_ups.question: At the coast, 5 teachers joined the students. How many people were in the group?

problem: Work out how many egg sandwiches the station cafe made this morning. It made 36 sandwiches, and all except 19 cheese ones were egg.
How many travellers were waiting in the departure lounge? Some had seats and some stood: 45 were sitting, and 27 stood by the big windows. Outside, a yellow truck was pulling a plane.

follow_ups.question: When boarding started, 30 travellers walked onto the plane. How many were still in the lounge?

problem: Hamid's party bags held 84 small gifts. How many were yo-yos? The bags had 29 whistles and 37 sticker sheets, and all the other gifts were yo-yos.

follow_ups.question: Each yo-yo cost 2 dollars. How much did the yo-yos cost?
Each whistle cost 1 dollar. How much did the whistles and yo-yos cost together?

problem: How many children came to story time at the library? There were 16 children on the rug and 11 on the benches, and the story was 25 pages long.

follow_ups.question: Halfway through, 4 more children arrived. How many children were listening then?
At the end, the librarian gave each child 2 stickers. How many stickers did she give out?
She had a roll of 70 stickers. How many were left on the roll?

problem: Kofi and Yaw scored 13 goals together this season. How many of those did Yaw score, if Kofi scored 8?

follow_ups.question: Next season Yaw scores 3 times as many goals. How many goals does he score next season?

problem: How much food do the zoo's elephants eat in a day? Their keepers give them 85 kilograms of hay and 37 kilograms of fruit.

follow_ups.question: Their mum used 20 strawberries for a cake. How many strawberries were still in the basket?

problem: Over two days, how many of Jamal's free throws went in? He made 26 on Monday and 19 on Tuesday.

follow_ups.question: On Wednesday he made 8 fewer than on Monday. What was his Wednesday total?

problem: How many swimmers are in the shallow end right now? The pool has 33 swimmers in the water: 14 are doing laps in the 8 lanes of the deep end, and the rest are in the shallow end.

follow_ups.question: A lifeguard blows the whistle and 6 swimmers leave the shallow end. How many are still there?
Then 9 children jump into the shallow end. Now how many swimmers are in the shallow end?

problem: What is the number of sea turtles at the aquarium? Six swim in the big tank and 11 tiny ones live in the nursery.

follow_ups.question: A school group buys 9 sculpture postcards. How many sculpture postcards are left on the rack?

problem: How many people did the city bus drop off on Saturday? It let off 78 people at the market stop and 65 at the park stop, and none anywhere else.

follow_ups.question: On Sunday the bus dropped off 20 fewer people. How many did it drop off on Sunday?
Over the whole weekend, how many people did it drop off?

problem: How many parking spaces at the train station are empty? There are 90 spaces; cars fill 37 of them and motorbikes fill 18.

follow_ups.question: Then 12 more cars park there. How many spaces are empty now?
Parking costs 3 dollars for each car. How much do all the cars parked there pay now?
Each motorbike pays 2 dollars. How much do the cars and motorbikes pay together?

problem: How many people are on Flight 27 to Nairobi? The plane has 38 passengers in the front section and 44 in the back.

follow_ups.question: The plane has 90 seats. How many are empty?

problem: Thirty-two children played games at Bao's party, and every child chose either musical chairs or tag. If 17 chose musical chairs, how many were playing tag?
Can you work out how many chairs the library cleaner has to wipe? There are 24 in the reading room and 18 around the computers.

follow_ups.question: A parent gives the library 6 beanbags. How many seats does the library have now?

problem: Of the 96 shirts the sports shop sold to the soccer club, 48 were red and 29 were white. Can you find how many were green, if no other colours were sold? A fox is printed on every shirt.

follow_ups.question: The club gives 3 green shirts to the goalkeepers. How many green shirts are left for the other players?
Those green shirts are shared equally between 2 teams. How many does each team get?

problem: How many empty buckets did the zookeeper take away this morning? She took away 15 from the lion pen and 23 from the bear pen.

follow_ups.question: She carries 2 buckets on each trip to the shed. How many trips does she make?

problem: Akira's vegetable patch has 4 long rows. How many bean plants grow there, if the patch holds 50 plants and 34 of them are carrots? Only carrots and beans grow in it.

follow_ups.question: Akira plants 8 more beans. How many bean plants are there now?
If every bean plant gives 3 pods, how many pods will he pick?
He cooks 40 pods for dinner. How many pods are left?

problem: What was the total number of drinks sold at the basketball game's snack stand? Fans bought 68 bottles of water and 45 bottles of juice.

follow_ups.question: Each drink cost 2 dollars. How much money did the stand take?
The club paid 90 dollars for the drinks. How much money did it keep?

problem: Twenty-seven children earned a swimming badge this week. How many earned a silver one? Every badge was bronze or silver, and 12 were bronze.
How many jellyfish glow in the dark room at the aquarium? There are 31 moon jellies and 26 blue jellies. Visitors have to whisper in that room.

follow_ups.question: Later, 7 baby jellies are moved into the room. How many jellyfish are in the room then?

problem: Find the number of young children among the space museum's 98 visitors on Tuesday. Of those visitors, 45 were adults and 29 were teenagers; everyone else was a young child.

follow_ups.question: Each young child got a free astronaut sticker from a pack of 50. How many stickers were left?
On Wednesday, twice as many young children came. How many young children came on Wednesday?

problem: How many seats does Bus 64 have? Along the left side there are 23 seats, and along the right side there are 19.

follow_ups.question: This morning 35 of the seats are taken. How many are free?
At the next stop, 4 people sit down in free seats. How many seats are still free?
So how many seats are taken now?

problem: The station's lost-and-found room held 45 umbrellas in all. How many were not black, if 28 of them were?

follow_ups.question: Owners collected 9 of the umbrellas that were not black. How many of those are still waiting in the room?

problem: What was the day's total of checked bags at the small airport's only desk? The morning shift took 87 bags and the evening shift took 76.
Of the 48 pizza slices at Nia's party, how many had pepperoni? Thirty were plain cheese, and all the other slices had pepperoni.

follow_ups.question: The guests ate 15 pepperoni slices. How many pepperoni slices were left?

problem: The magazine stand in the school library has two shelves: 13 animal magazines on the top shelf and 22 sports magazines on the bottom one. What is the number of magazines on the stand?

follow_ups.question: The librarian takes away 5 old sports magazines. How many magazines are on the stand now?

problem: How many orange slices are in the green box? The coach packed 28 slices for her 11 players, putting 19 in the blue box and the rest in the green one.

follow_ups.question: She adds 6 more slices to the green box. How many are in the green box now?
What is the total number of orange slices in both boxes now?

problem: How many animals live in the zoo's petting farm, if it has 9 goats and 14 sheep and nothing else?
The garden club picked 93 tomatoes on Sunday. How many were still green, if 57 had already turned red? Everyone washed their hands at the tap afterwards.

follow_ups.question: The next day, 18 of the green tomatoes turned red. How many red tomatoes does the club have now?

problem: How many games have the Tigers played this season? They won 14 and lost 9, with no ties.

follow_ups.question: There are 30 games in the season. How many are still to play?
If the Tigers win all of those games, how many wins will they have?

problem: Lemon, cherry and orange were the only ice lollies the pool's snack bar had. It sold 85 of them on the hottest day: 36 lemon, 27 cherry and the rest orange. What number of orange lollies did it sell?

follow_ups.question: Orange lollies cost 2 dollars each. How much money did the orange lollies bring in?
The next day the snack bar sold 9 more orange lollies than on the hottest day. How many orange lollies did it sell that day?
Over those two days, how many orange lollies did it sell?

problem: How many seahorses does the aquarium keep? Tank A has 18 and Tank B has 13, and the youngest seahorse is only 2 weeks old.

follow_ups.question: Then 5 baby seahorses are born in Tank B. How many seahorses does the aquarium have now?

problem: The museum's 34 stuffed birds are split between the forest room and the ocean room. How many are in the ocean room, when the forest room has 20?
The castle tour bus carries 18 adults and 15 children. Altogether, how many tourists is it carrying?

follow_ups.question: At the castle, the tourists walk around in groups of 3. How many groups are there?

problem: Morning papers and evening papers fill the station newsstand, 55 newspapers in all. If 32 are morning papers, how many evening papers are there? Trains leave every few minutes from the platform behind it.

follow_ups.question: Commuters buy 15 evening papers. How many evening papers are left?
A van brings 20 more evening papers. What is the number of evening papers now?

problem: How many lost things wait at the airport's lost-property desk? A worker counts 26 lost umbrellas and 17 lost hats.

follow_ups.question: Owners collect 12 of the umbrellas. How many lost things are still at the desk?

problem: How many plain cookies did Rafael's aunt bake for his party at 3 o'clock? She baked 84, and the only ones that were not plain had chocolate chips: 47 of those.

follow_ups.question: The guests ate 25 plain cookies. How many plain cookies were left?
They also ate 35 chocolate-chip cookies. Altogether, how many cookies were left?

problem: What is the total number of new books the school library received this week, if the publisher sent 64 and the parents' club gave 57?

follow_ups.question: The librarian sets 11 of them aside for repair. How many new books are ready to lend?
The ready books go onto shelves that hold 10 each. Work out how many shelves she fills.

problem: How many teams came from out of town? Only 15 of the 24 teams at the soccer tournament are local.
How many flamingos are standing in the zoo's pond? 27 stand on one leg and 16 stand on both legs. Flamingos get their pink colour from the shrimp they eat.

follow_ups.question: At sunset, 9 of the flamingos walk out of the water. How many are left standing in the pond?

problem: The city garden's new hedge is made of 91 bushes, lavender and roses. Exactly 64 are lavender. So how many rose bushes are in the hedge?

follow_ups.question: Each rose bush gets 2 bags of soil. How many bags of soil do the gardeners need?
They already have 30 bags. How many more bags must they buy?

problem: How many people watched the 6 o'clock basketball game? 41 sat on the home side and 35 on the visitors' side.

follow_ups.question: The gym has 90 seats. How many seats were empty?

How many more people watch the next game than this one?

problem: How many kickboards are in the pool's float bin? Noodles and kickboards combined make 50 floats, and 32 of them are noodles.

follow_ups.question: Swimmers take out 7 kickboards. How many kickboards are still in the bin?

problem: Altogether, how many fish swim in the aquarium's two biggest tanks? The shark tank holds 58 fish and the reef tank holds 96.
Sixty hard hats hang in the building zone of the children's museum. How many of them are orange? 44 are yellow, and all the rest are orange.

follow_ups.question: A group of 12 children each put on an orange hat. How many orange hats are still hanging?
Then 30 children put on yellow hats. How many yellow hats are still hanging?

problem: How many children climbed off the school bus at the zoo gate? There were 21 girls and 26 boys on board, and all of them got off.

follow_ups.question: Each child pays 2 dollars to get into the zoo. How much do the children pay altogether?

problem: The freight train rolling through the station has 2 engines and 94 containers. Find how many containers are red, given that 57 are blue and the rest are red.

follow_ups.question: At the station, workers lift off 19 red containers. How many red containers stay on the train?

problem: Before lunch, how many planes took off? The control tower counted 13 from the north runway and 8 from the south runway.

follow_ups.question: Omar's mum made 20 goodie bags, one for each school friend. How many bags were left over?

problem: How long did Fatima spend reading in the library over the first two days of reading week? On Monday she read for 25 minutes, which is less than her 35 minutes on Tuesday.

follow_ups.question: On Wednesday she read for 15 minutes less than on Tuesday. How long did she read on Wednesday?
What was her reading time in minutes over the three days?

problem: How many penalty shots went in during the soccer club's shoot-out contest? The players took 86 shots, and the goalkeepers stopped 49 of them.

follow_ups.question: Each goal earned 2 points. How many points did the shooters earn?
Each save earned 1 point for the goalkeepers. How many more points did the shooters earn than the goalkeepers?
Next year the club hopes for 5 more goals than this year. How many goals is that?

problem: How many tickets did the zoo sell in its first hour? It opens at 9, and by ten o'clock it had sold 32 adult tickets and 45 child tickets.

follow_ups.question: By noon, 18 more tickets were sold. How many tickets had the zoo sold by noon?

problem: Wanjiru counts 37 butterflies in the garden; 22 are flying about, and the others sit on flowers. Find how many are sitting.
How many points did the Yilmaz sisters score this season? Zeynep scored 87 and Elif scored 64.

follow_ups.question: Their cousin Emre scored 29 fewer points than Elif. How many points did Emre score?

problem: After the swim lesson, how many towels are wet? Of the 45 towels handed out, 27 were never used. The lifeguard's whistle hangs on a red string.

follow_ups.question: The wet towels go into a washer that holds 9 towels at a time. How many loads are needed?
Each load takes 40 minutes. How many minutes of washing is that?

problem: How many people watched the sea lion show? There were fewer children than adults: 29 children and 43 adults.

follow_ups.question: The next show had 15 more people. How many people watched the next show?

problem: How many electric model trains does the toy museum show in Hall 4? There are 48 model trains in the hall; 26 are steam trains, and all the rest run on electricity.

follow_ups.question: Two electric trains are sent away for repair. How many electric trains are still on show?
The museum buys 5 new steam trains. How many steam trains does it show now?
What is the number of model trains on show in the hall now?

problem: How far did the two buses drive in total? The red one drove 78 kilometres today and the green one drove 69.

follow_ups.question: Tomorrow the red bus will drive 12 kilometres more than today. How far will it drive tomorrow?
The green bus will drive the same as today. How far will both buses drive tomorrow?

problem: Outside on the platforms, how many benches are there? Of the station's 31 benches, 17 stand inside the waiting room.
How many hot drinks did the airport cafe sell this morning? Its baristas made 73 coffees and 59 cups of tea. The cafe is right next to the duty-free shop.

follow_ups.question: In the afternoon it sold 47 fewer hot drinks than in the morning. What was its afternoon total?

problem: The class party had 94 juice boxes in a big cooler. Apple juice made up 38 of them, orange juice 27, and grape juice the rest. Find the number of grape juice boxes.

follow_ups.question: Children drank 21 grape juice boxes. How many grape juice boxes were left?
Nobody drank any other juice. How many juice boxes were in the cooler after that?

problem: How many games can children borrow from the library's games corner on the 2nd floor? There are 18 board games and 15 card games.

follow_ups.question: Today, 9 board games are out on loan. How many games are still in the corner?
A family returns 4 of the board games. How many games are in the corner now?
The corner's shelf has room for 40 games. How many more games can fit?

problem: What was the Bears' score in the final? The Lions scored 5 goals, and the two teams scored 9 goals in total.

follow_ups.question: In the next match the Bears score twice as many goals. How many goals do they score?

problem: Lemurs leap all over the zoo's little island: 8 grown-ups and 6 babies. How many lemurs is that?
The school garden grows raspberries and blueberries on 44 bushes. If 26 bushes are raspberry, find how many are blueberry.

follow_ups.question: Each blueberry bush gives 3 cups of berries. How many cups of blueberries does the garden give?
